state.error_body: We could not load this event's team. Check your connection and try again.
state.denied_body: Only hosts who can manage the team can open this screen.

accept.error_invalid: That invitation is no longer valid. It may have been used, withdrawn, or sent to a different account.
accept.error_unavailable: That invitation can no longer be accepted. Ask the host to send a new one.
accept.error_removed: A host removed you from this event, so you can't rejoin it.
accept.error_generic: We could not accept that invitation. Open the link again.

members.title: Team
members.empty_body: Invite a co-host to share the work, or staff to help at the door.

role.confirm_body: {{name}} becomes {{role}} for this event. You can change it again at any time.
role.error_conflict: That person's role changed before you did. Reload the team and try again.
role.error_forbidden: You cannot change that person's role on this event.
role.hint_cohost: Runs the event with you: edits the details, the tickets and the page, and sees guest contact details.
role.hint_coordinator: Runs the day: the roster, the answers, check-in, the broadcast and the chat. Changes nothing, and never sees an email or a phone number.
role.hint_staff: Helps at the door: a contact-free roster and check-in, nothing else.

manage.error_generic: That change did not go through. Try again.
manage.error_conflict: This team changed before you did. Reload it and try again.
manage.error_forbidden: You cannot make that change on this event.
manage.error_gone: That is no longer on this team.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.privacy_note: An invited email is stored masked. You will never see the full address.
invite.limit_reached: This event already has the maximum number of open invitations.
invite.handle_invalid: A handle is 3 to 20 letters, numbers or underscores.
invite.error_generic: That invite could not be sent.
invite.error_conflict: That person is already on the team, or already has an open invite.
invite.error_forbidden: That person cannot be invited to this event.
invite.error_rate_limited: This event has sent too many invites today. Try again tomorrow.
invite.error_invalid: Check the handle or email address and try again.
